Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one independent photoreal rehabilitation demonstration photograph, no collage. Input images 1-3 are identity/style/background references: preserve exactly the same adult East Asian woman, same face, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal dark-gray trousers, realistic ordinary adult head/body/limb proportions, natural skin texture, soft studio lighting and the same muted cool gray-blue seamless background.
